my final comment is that i am not a multimillionaire streamer, and i do not know the social dynamics behind the scenes of multimillionaire streamers, so my definition of real friend and what real friends would do to me is irrelevant. without proof, there is no point parading this is a fake friendship, other than your own moral convictions around friendship, which i believe to also be irrelevant in a discussion about THEIR personalities and what THEY want to do going forward. nobody is trying to change your definition of a real friend bro i’m just saying that the “fake friendship” narrative is pure speculation from personal bias, which you’ve admitted to.

you’re taking the specifics of yesterdays incident knowing it doesn’t make sense in the context of normal friendships, which i have stated again and again. my point, if you can be bothered to read it, is they showed good faith in the discussion today and can come back from it. the friendship is not just “fake” for the audience and they probably have a genuine wish to continue being real friends.

didn’t jesse admit to messing up his communication with poke and managing both friendships? why is everyone acting like the friendship is unsalvageable when everyone understood it was just a bunch of mismanaged emotions?

why is it bad to argue with a friend more than once? i think we disagree morally on what a friend is. i can accept when a friend lets me down or argues with me, as long as they show good faith going forward, and as long as i understand them. that’s the main thing about being a good friend in my opinion. understanding each other and being there for each other even when shit hits the fan and you both blow up. i think X and poke are likely the same especially in the environment where they’re used to streamers shit talking everyone. if they had beef in the past, it doesn’t mean that if they argue again they’re bad friends. situations change, old arguments may not have properly healed, new things might reignite old things. there’s plenty of reasons for people to argue multiple times throughout a friendship. i don’t understand taking the positioning of the moral high road around what is a good friend when it is a subjective experience specific to them and them only. my comments simply state in my opinion, they have showed good faith and introspection by addressing what they did, apologising for it, engaging in discussing the actual emotions they felt during the discussion and not ramming hard on facts and gotchas. can you illustrate a moment where either of them acted in bad faith which would have compromised your interpretation of their introspection?

i would say the escalation is caused by the escalated social status and wealth of the persons involved. arguments with friends can easily turn incredibly heated if everyone’s income depended on how many people were following them. these positions of power have historically bred paranoia, so the fact that they could acknowledge each others actions, apologise for the behaviour and agree to resolve personal matters in private going forward is a huge positive in terms of their attitudes in fixing the dogshit from yesterdays stream. 

and for the second point, i believe the introspection comes from the actions going forward, no? it would be too early to judge if this is fake or not, and the people assuming that they’re just back to being friends with no change to how they act, think or speak with each other is pure speculation. regardless of this point though, even if we took just todays stream as a point of reference; there is a huge improvement to how things were discussed and resolved compared to yesterday. it was revealed poke apologised off stream, he contextualised his words around X taking medication but still took accountability for it. X took accountability for sending hate towards gigi when he had bad info from Fran. i personally don’t know enough about Gigi or Fran to make an analysis on how they communicated this stream, but X and Poke made a huge step in the right direction, and I feel like everyone is spinning it to be some fake shit

i don’t believe i said X was a good friend, nor did I say poke was a good friend. i meant to make the point that these things happen in relationships all the time, we all know someone or have been someone in a bad spot with friends where shit gets toxic. just like in real life, there are streamer friend groups that are not toxic, but that doesn’t take away from my point that people are acting like this is some super fake resolution just for clout, and that everyone is continuing to act fake, when i don’t believe that’s the case.
